HERO.TITLE: Jardinería Norat
HERO.SUBTITLE: Garden design and care
HERO.DESCRIPTION: We are specialists in the design and maintenance of gardens, swimming pools, and plots in Mallorca. We offer professional care and a relationship of absolute trust for private clients and communities.

ABOUT.TITLE: About Us
ABOUT.P1: My name is Norat Salom. I started this small company in 2020 with a clear objective: to offer professional solutions and a close relationship in the care of outdoor spaces. Currently, we form the team together with my colleague Constantino Ebana, keeping our essence of a local, honest, and efficient company intact.
ABOUT.P2: Our proposal is simple: to guarantee constant communication, impeccable work, and build long-term trust relationships so that the maintenance of your garden or pool is a pleasant and worry-free experience.
ABOUT.ALT_IMG: Norat Salom and Constantino Ebana - Jardinería Norat Team

SERVICES.TITLE: Our Services
SERVICES.S1_DESC: We create personalized, aesthetic, and functional environments tailored to your space.
SERVICES.S2_DESC: Comprehensive and constant care adapted to the needs of each season.
SERVICES.S3_DESC: Cleaning, technical control, and optimal tuning throughout the year.
SERVICES.S4_DESC: Scheduled services to ensure clean and safe common areas.
SERVICES.S5_DESC: Thorough cleaning of weeds and vegetation on plots and land.
SERVICES.S6_DESC: Structural pruning of trees and shrubs with complete removal of green waste.

FLORA.TITLE: Available Flora
FLORA.SUBTITLE: Discover the local flora of Mallorca
FLORA.PLANT_Adelfa_DESC: Very hardy evergreen shrub with brightly colored flowers, ideal for hedges in Mediterranean climates.
FLORA.PLANT_Agapanto_DESC: Ornamental plant with beautiful clustered flowers in blue or white tones, perfect for borders.
FLORA.PLANT_Agave_DESC: Large succulent with fleshy and spiky leaves, ideal for low maintenance gardens.
FLORA.PLANT_Algarrobo_DESC: Evergreen Mediterranean tree that offers dense shade and produces sweet edible pods.
FLORA.PLANT_Buganvilla_DESC: Spectacular climbing shrub with vibrant colored bracts and great sun resistance.
FLORA.PLANT_Ciprés Totem_DESC: Very compact upright columnar tree, ideal for creating elegant visual boundaries.
FLORA.PLANT_Jazmín Estrellado_DESC: Dense foliage climber with delicate, highly scented white flowers blooming in spring.
FLORA.PLANT_Lantana_DESC: Hardy flowering shrub whose flowers change color, attracting butterflies and pollinators.
FLORA.PLANT_Lavanda_DESC: Aromatic plant with deep purple flowers, famous for its relaxing fragrance and properties.
FLORA.PLANT_Limonero_DESC: Citrus fruit tree that produces acidic fruits and highly aromatic leaves for most of the year.
FLORA.PLANT_Naranjo_DESC: Classic fruit tree with scented orange blossoms and glossy green leaves, producing delicious oranges.
FLORA.PLANT_Olivo_DESC: Ancient Mediterranean tree with silvery leaves, known for its longevity and olive production.
FLORA.PLANT_Palmito_DESC: Shrubby palm native to the Mediterranean region, very hardy and of great ornamental value.
FLORA.PLANT_Romero_DESC: Very hardy evergreen aromatic shrub, ideal for seasoning and with year-round foliage.
FLORA.PLANT_Santolina_DESC: Small compact shrub with silvery leaves and abundant yellow button-like flowers.
FLORA.PLANT_Strelitzia_DESC: Exotic plant known as "bird of paradise" due to the shape and bright colors of its flowers.
